content_sections.heading: About BSPP
content_sections.text: The Bihar Shiksha Pariyojana Parishad is an autonomous body under the Education Department, Government of Bihar, with its office at Shiksha Bhawan, Saidpur, Rajendranagar, Patna. It is engaged in the execution of the Government scheme for the State of Bihar. This panel will handle its various legal matters at the Patna High Court.

content_sections.heading: BSPP Advocate Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Payment is made at the rates approved by the Executive Committee of the BSPP. content_sections.heading: BSPP Advocate Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The applicant must be an L.L.B. degree holder (approved by Bar Council of India) from a recognized university. He or she should be a practicing advocate at the Patna High Court. The advocate should have adequate setup and infrastructure to deal with the cases. The advocate shall not appear against the BSPP in any matter before any forum, court or tribunal. The application form asks for the year of enrollment, enrollment number, total experience in years, and proof of essential qualification and essential experience. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

rows.event: Last date for receipt of application

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Advocates will be empanelled through an interview, and only shortlisted candidates shall be called for it. Applications are first scrutinised. Any application that is not in the desired format, legible or complete, lacks clear information, or fails a relevant requirement will be rejected for further evaluation at the sole discretion of the BSPP. The BSPP may verify the information given and reject an application at any time during the process if its contents appear incorrect, inaccurate or inappropriate. The decision of the State Project Director on accepting or rejecting any or all applications will be final.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: No contractual obligation whatsoever shall arise from the application process. Shortlisting or empanelment does not create any right to be appointed as dealing Advocate in any case or matter.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BSPP Advocate Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare the application in the format enclosed with the notice. It asks for your name, correspondence address, mobile number, email ID, educational qualification, and location and court of practice, along with your enrollment and experience details. Type the application on A4 size paper and keep all pages in serial order. Sign every page, and fill in the place, date, and your name and address at the end of the form. Any interlineations, erasures or overwriting shall be considered invalid. Put the hard copy and the complete set of supporting documents in an envelope and seal it. Write "Application for empanelment of Advocates" on the envelope. Send it by registered or speed post to: State Project Director, Bihar Shiksha Pariyojana Parishad, Shiksha Bhawan, Saidpur, Rajendranagar, Patna 800004. Documents to enclose: Documentary proof in support of essential qualification Documentary proof in support of essential experience Any other documents in support of the application Applicants bear all costs of submitting the application. The BSPP is not responsible for applications that do not arrive in time for any reason, including postal delays or a holiday in between.

faq.question: Q1. How much does BSPP pay an empanelled advocate for a hearing?
faq.answer: The rate is ₹3,125/- for each appearance, hearing and argument before the Patna High Court, plus clerkage at 10% on the professional fee.

faq.question: Q2. Do advocates already on the BSPP panel need to apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Advocates already empanelled in the BSPP will have to apply afresh for empanelment.

faq.question: Q3. Can I practice in another court and still apply?
faq.answer: The notice requires the applicant to be a practicing advocate at the Patna High Court, and the form asks for your location and court of practice.

faq.question: Q4. Is the last date for posting or for receipt?
faq.answer: It is for receipt. The application must reach the BSPP office in Patna by 05:00 PM on the last date, so post it well in advance.

faq.question: Q5. Can the application be handwritten?
faq.answer: No. It should be typed on A4 size paper, with all pages numbered in serial order and signed.

faq.question: Q6. Will every applicant be interviewed?
faq.answer: No. Only shortlisted candidates shall be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Will BSPP pay travel costs for the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA / DA will be admissible for appearing at the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Does empanelment guarantee cases from BSPP?
faq.answer: No. Being shortlisted or empanelled gives no right to be appointed as dealing Advocate in any case or matter.

faq.question: Q9. Can I represent a party against BSPP after joining the panel?
faq.answer: No. Advocates shall not appear against the BSPP in any matter before any forum, court or tribunal.
